drafts.body:
Hello David Rubenstein Atrium at Lincoln Center team,

I’m writing on behalf of the Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation (Smile Like Sab). We are exploring venues for our Manhattan Spring Gala, a proposed reception in New York, NY, for an estimated 150 attendees on April 17, 2027. The evening would honor Sabrina and include a short talk from a recovery speaker.

Could you please let us know whether the Atrium is available that date and suitable for this attendance? We would also appreciate information about capacity, pricing, any deposit requirements, catering options, and accessibility. Do you offer nonprofit rates or other accommodations for nonprofit events?

Thank you for your time. We would be glad to learn more about the possibilities.

Warm regards,
[Board member name]
Sabrina Audrey Milone Foundation (Smile Like Sab)
[Phone]
